description: This file defines the SpellCheckerSettingsActivity class, which is a PreferenceActivity used to display and manage spell checker preferences within the Android app. It overrides lifecycle methods to set up the preferences screen with a specific fragment.

classes.name: SpellCheckerSettingsActivity
classes.description: An activity that displays spell checker preferences, utilizing a fragment for the preference UI.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, setting up the preferences UI, called during activity creation.

methods.name: getIntent
methods.description: Returns a customized intent with extras indicating which fragment to display and header options.

methods.name: isValidFragment
methods.description: Validates the fragment name to prevent malicious fragment injection.
